item.description:
**Tuck a chat behind its page.** When a page a chat published is open beside the chat, the Tuck button in the chat's header hides the chat to the left and gives the page the whole tab. A glass bookmark on the edge shows the chat's light: click it to bring the chat out over the page, click again to tuck it, and use its lower button (or ⌘⇧↩) to put the chat back beside the page.
**Talk to the chat from the page.** With the chat tucked, its message box floats on the page, names the page in a chip, and has Attach This View in its + menu.
**Review a page on the Mac.** Review (⌃⌥R) records what you say while you circle things on the page (turn on the pen or hold ⌥ and drag). Stop, add any words, press Return, and the chat comes back beside the page with your review.
